50386658.DESCRIPTION: Inhibition of human MDM2 L33E mutant (14 to 111 residues) by ITC method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: To understand the thermodynamic parameters of the interactions in solution, isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) was carried out using I and human MDM2 (using the construct MDM2[14–111,L33E]). The thermodynamic signature is shown in Table 6B. Overall, both the ΔH and −TΔS contributions are favorable (i.e., negative), which correlates with the favorable van der Waals interactions made by compound 1 which do not lead to a strong rigidification of MDM2. Finally, as shown in Table 6C, a thermal shift assay, also called differential scanning fluorimetry (DSF), was done to measure the thermal stability increase of human MDM2 upon binding of 1 to the protein. For compound 1, thermal stabilization with a ΔT of 25 °C was observed, which correlates with the low nM affinity.
